records.text: Turning Point USA donors who attended the Aspen presentation told Candace Owens that the released audio of Charlie Kirk naming Erika Kirk as his successor was completely faked.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #1 (Ep eLgD5yUVbko)

appearances.snippet: donors have contacted me, Turning Point USA donors that were in Aspen ... They told me that that audio is completely faked and they are shocked.

records.text: Two Turning Point USA donors who attended the Aspen presentation told Candace Owens that Charlie Kirk never said Erika Kirk should run Turning Point USA if something happened to him.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #1 (Ep eLgD5yUVbko)

appearances.snippet: I had another two donors reach out to me who were present at this Aspen event and they were shocked. ... And they said unequivocally, that did not happen. Charlie never uttered those words.

records.text: The Aspen donors told Candace Owens that Charlie Kirk did not mention Erika Kirk at a smaller dinner where about 12 people discussed his future plans for Turning Point USA.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #1 (Ep eLgD5yUVbko)

appearances.snippet: There was even a smaller dinner that took place later with just about 12 people in attendance that took place after the presentation. ... They asked him about his future plans for turning point, and Erika was never mentioned.
